option_relations.rationale: The option describes a mixed mold infection with specific pathogens causing disseminated mucormycosis, which is a broader category that includes rhinocerebral mucormycosis (the leaf).
The option describes a mixed fungal infection with Mucorales involvement, which is a broader category that includes rhinocerebral mucormycosis (the leaf).

The option 'Mucormycosis (Rhino-orbital-cerebral)' is clinically equivalent to 'Acute invasive fungal rhinosinusitis due to mucormycosis (rhinocerebral mucormycosis)' as both refer to the same clinical entity.

The option 'Rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis' is clinically equivalent to 'Acute invasive fungal rhinosinusitis due to mucormycosis (rhinocerebral mucormycosis)' as both refer to the same clinical entity.
